chordInfo.name: Extended Chords
chordInfo.subtitle: Explore the rich, colorful world of extended chords - 9ths, 11ths, and 13ths that add depth and sophistication to your harmony.

fundamentals.label: Definition
fundamentals.value: Chords that extend beyond the 7th to include 9th, 11th, and 13th

boxes.title: Interval Stacking
items: Voice leading: Choose most important tones

boxes.title: Practical Voicings
items: Guitar has 6 strings: Omit notes as needed
Common omissions: 5th, root (if bass plays it)
Rootless voicings: Assume bass covers root

voicingGroups.title: Essential Extended Chord Voicings
voicingGroups.tipDescription: These are practical extended chord voicings that work well on guitar.

items.title: Funk 9th Chord Groove
items.description: Classic funk progression using dominant 9th chords - the foundation of funk guitar heard in James Brown and Prince songs.

techniqueItems: Practice muting unused strings for clean voicings
Focus on the most important chord tones (3, 7, extension)
Use rhythmic strumming to bring extended chords to life
Build from 7th chords by adding one extension at a time
applicationItems: Essential for jazz, funk, and R&B styles
Adds richness and color to any progression
Foundation for modern harmony and arranging
